product_summary: Media intelligence platform for PR and comms teams, monitoring print, online, broadcast and social coverage, with analytics, journalist contacts and API/data-as-a-service delivery of enriched media content.

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: Onclusive API solutions give you enterprise-grade access to 28+ million daily media content items

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched onclusive.com homepage, products/media-monitoring, data-as-a-service and site-wide searches for 'newsletter'. No newsletter or email-newsletter source type is documented; coverage is described by channel: print, online, broadcast, social.
verified_gap: Documented coverage enumerates four channels (print, online, broadcast, social); no newsletter/email channel is named, so newsletter-native coverage and newsletter-level publisher metadata are absent from their stated source set.

evidence.quote: Monitor 28M+ earned media items daily across 60,000 print titles, 3M websites and 12,000+ broadcast sources worldwide.
Track global media coverage in real-time with AI-powered monitoring across print, online, broadcast and social media.
Onclusive API solutions give you enterprise-grade access to 28+ million daily media content items, thousands of media contacts

likely_buyer_role: VP/Director of Product or Head of Content/Data Partnerships for the media intelligence platform and DaaS line
caveats: Their '3M websites' crawl may incidentally capture web-hosted newsletter archives, which weakens the gap at the margin; the channel list is a product enumeration, not an explicit exclusion of newsletters. Contact email is a general company address, not a named buyer.
